div.p: This page describes how to use BCP 13 with HL7 Standards.

tr.td: BCP 13 technical specification is managed by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF)
The URI urn:ietf:bcp:13 identifies the BCP 13 code system
BCP 13 is not versioned like a traditional code system with versioned releases. Accordingly, standardised version values are not defined. Version values SHALL therefore be ommited.
A BCP 13 code is any valid media type based on the grammar defined in the BCP 13 technical specification.
The correct display for a BCP 13 code is the BCP 13 code itself
All BCP 13 must be assumed to be active. IANA maintains formal registries of BCP 13 based media types and these are also permanent.
No Subsumption relationships are defined by BCP 13
There are some defined - see below

div.p: The full copyright statement and information about copyright, IP and licensing for BCP 13 and its related specifications (RFC 4289, RFC 6838 and RFC 9694) can be found on the IETF's BCP 13 page.
This specification defines two filters that may be used with the BCP 13 code system.

tr.td: Filters the code system based on the begining of a BCP 13 code and includes all concepts that starts with the filter value. The filter value may be the type, prefix and subtype parts represented using the BCP 13 grammar. For example, if filter has a value of text, only BCP 13 concepts starting with text/ are included. Similarly, application/vnd.oasis.opendocument is a filter value that includes a prefix, and application/pdf is a filter value with a type and subtype.
When true only BCP 13 media types that are part of the IANA registry (https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types) are included.

div.p: There are no general implicit value set formula defined for BCP 13.
